author: pokrzywnik
body: As an owner of over 300 shops which I still visit I can give you some niche examples (as others stated there was no grand market before). But there are items that you can't "farm" with grand market efficient. For example monster remains - max stack is 2 for grand market and for normal shop - also 2. Candles drowsing rods also have that issue. No matter what I do first thing after launching orna is using drowsing rod xp potion and both coins. So I use a lot of them even if I login just for a few minutes. Shops make my monster remains spawn fiesta better, give drowsing rods and does not cost any gold to restock way more items than my lvl 60 grand market. Yes it can be a bit time consuming to search through them but they are not entirely pointless as others say.
